picture-pairs.name: Picture pairs
picture-pairs.seoTitle: Matching Game for Dementia: Picture Pairs
picture-pairs.h1: Picture Pairs: ekeir gemu ni kakoren ko ekeir ni matching
picture-pairs.description: Gemu ni matching ko ekeir ni kakoren, ni free, ngaran ekeir ko dementia. Ekeir ko boboto ebwe tu ara ngaran, ko timer ma score ren ngaran, ko 4 ma 12 tiles ebwe ko ni taburi.
picture-pairs.short: Kakoren ekeir ruwe ko ebwe same. Ekeir ebwe tu ara ngaran.
picture-pairs.intro: Tap ekeir, ko tap ekeir ni match ren ekeir ko. Ekeir ebwe tu ara ngaran ngaran ekeir, bwe ngaran nei ngaran nana ko. Ekeir ruwe ko ebwe ko gold border ma check mark.
howTo: Ko taburi tiles ko ebwe kamot. Four tiles ebwe ko ni place ni toa.
Tap ekeir ruwe. Ebwe ko gold border.
Tap ekeir ko ebwe tu same. Pair ebwe tu ara ngaran ko check mark.
Ngaran ekeir ruwe ko different, ebwe tu ko bad. Tap ruwe ngaran ko ebwe ko ready.
Turn on "Hidden pictures" ni ngaran ruwe ko ebwe enjoy classic face-down version.
tips: Name ekeir ruwe ko ebwe out loud ma chat ni ngaran ekeir: "A red teacup. Do you take milk in your tea?"
Ngaran ekeir ko ebwe tap, ko ebwe kamot, ngaran tap ko ebwe toa. Point ren ngaran tap.
Stay ni four tiles ngaran ko ebwe good. More tiles ebwe ko choice, ko level ren ngaran.
Finish ngaran ko enjoyable. One game ebwe ko complete activity.

faq.q: Ko timer ma score?
faq.a: Ko. Ko clock, score, move counter ma losing. Ko ebwe stop ngaran moment, ma stop halfway ebwe ko good way ren finish.

faq.q: Bwe ekeir ebwe tu up?
faq.a: Ngaran ekeir ko visible ebwe ko game ren looking ma matching, ko remembering. Ekeir ebwe calm. Ko ebwe switch ren hidden pictures ni one tap ngaran ko prefer.

faq.q: Ko free ma ko sign up?
faq.a: Ko, ngaran free, ko account, sign-up ma download. Ebwe work ni web browser ni phone, tablet ma computer.

faq.q: Ebwe ko use ekeir family ami?
faq.a: Ko. Tire Photo pairs, ebwe ko choose ekeir ni device ami. Ekeir ebwe tu ni browser ko ma ko upload.

find-the-same.name: Find the same
find-the-same.seoTitle: Find the Same Picture: Simple Dementia Game
find-the-same.description: Ekeir ruwe ni top, two ma four ni below. Tap ekeir ko same. Gemu ni ekeir ni calm ma free ren ekeir ko dementia, ko timer.
find-the-same.short: Look ekeir ni top ma tap ekeir ko same ni below.
find-the-same.intro: Ekeir ruwe ebwe tu ni top ren screen. Ni below ebwe ko two, three ma four ekeir. Tap ekeir ko same. Ko one simple choice ni ngaran time, ma room ren talk.
howTo: Ko choose two, three ma four ekeir ren pick. Two ebwe simplest.
Look ekeir ni top together.
Tap ekeir same ni below. Ebwe ko marked ni check ma warm words.
Ngaran ekeir different ko tapped, gemu ebwe name ekeir ma wait. Take time.
Tap "Next picture" ngaran ko ready ren another.
tips: Talk ren each ekeir before choosing: colors, shapes, where ko might see it.
Two choices ko "too easy". Goal ko pleasant moment, ko challenge.
Ngaran tapping ko hard, ekeir ebwe point ma ko ebwe tap ren ekeir.

faq.q: Ko timer ma score?
faq.a: Ko. Ko clock, score, move counter ma losing. Ko ebwe stop ngaran moment, ma stop halfway ebwe ko good way ren finish.

faq.q: Bwe ekeir different ko tapped?
faq.a: Ko unpleasant. Ko buzzer, red cross ma shaking. Gemu ebwe name ekeir ko tapped ma wait ren next tap.

faq.q: Ko free ma ko sign up?
faq.a: Ko, ngaran free, ko account, sign-up ma download. Ebwe work ni web browser ni phone, tablet ma computer.

shadow-match.name: Shadow match
shadow-match.seoTitle: Shadow Matching Game for Dementia: Free Online
shadow-match.h1: Shadow Match: ekeir gemu ni calm
shadow-match.description: Shadow ni dark ni top, two ma four ekeir ni below. Tap ekeir ko ebwe tu shadow. Gemu ni free ma calm ren shadow matching ko dementia, ko timer.
shadow-match.short: Look shadow ma tap ekeir ko ebwe tu shadow.
shadow-match.intro: Shadow matching ko activity ko familiar ni printed worksheets, ngaran ni large ekeir ma ko print. Shadow ni soft ebwe tu ni top ren screen ma two, three ma four ekeir ebwe wait ni below. Tap ekeir ko ebwe tu shadow. Shapes ke bicycle, umbrella ma teacup ko easy ren talk.
howTo: Ko choose two, three ma four ekeir ren pick. Two ebwe simplest.
Look shadow together. Shape ko? Tall ma round?
Tap ekeir ko ebwe tu shadow. Name ren ekeir ebwe appear ni below shadow.
Ngaran ekeir different ko tapped, gemu ebwe name ma wait. Take time.
Tap "Next shadow" ngaran ko ready ren another.
tips: Trace outline ren shadow ni finger ma talk ren shape.
Ngaran shadows ko hard ni day ngaran, switch ren Find the same, ngaran ekeir ebwe alike.
Talk ren ekeir ngaran found: "We had an umbrella like that."

faq.q: Ko timer ma score?
faq.a: Ko. Ko clock, score, move counter ma losing. Ko ebwe stop ngaran moment, ma stop halfway ebwe ko good way ren finish.

faq.q: Ese mwiniwin shadow matching ngan eda ren dementia?
faq.a: E ese dogig ngan eda ko mwin ngaiye, naba ngan eda ren mwin ko dementia. Ren eda e dogig ngan shapes ngan ena ngaiyen ngan words. E ngan ngaiye ma kokoro, ma ese test, ma ese mwiniwin ko dementia ke ese ketheng ko dementia. Ngan ena e kiroa ngaiye ngan eda, tuwen "Find the same", ke look at pictures together.

faq.q: Ese ko ngaiyeng ngan eda ngan ena ngan picture ko ese tika?
faq.a: Ese ko ngaiye ngan ena. Ese buzzer, ese red cross, ese shaking. E ngan ena ngan picture ko eda ebwe tapped, ma e ngan ngaiye ngan tap ko mwin.

faq.q: E free ma ese ngan sign up?
faq.a: Ae, e free, ma ese account, ese sign-up, ese download. E ngan ena ngan web browser ko phone, tablet ke computer.

sort-together.name: Sort together
sort-together.seoTitle: Sorting Game for Dementia: Sort Together
sort-together.h1: Sort Together: a Picture Sorting Activity
sort-together.description: Tap a picture, then tap the basket it belongs in: kitchen or garden, fruit or animals. A calm, free sorting activity for people living with dementia.
sort-together.short: Put each picture in its basket: kitchen or garden, and more.
sort-together.intro: Sorting is a familiar, satisfying everyday task, like putting away groceries or pairing socks. Tap a picture, then tap the basket where it belongs. There is no rush and no wrong turn.
howTo: Pick a theme: kitchen and garden, fruit and animals, or home and travel.
Tap a picture. It gets a gold border.
Tap the basket it belongs in. The picture moves into that basket.
If it belongs in the other basket, the game says so gently and waits.
When every picture is sorted, look through the baskets together.
tips: There are often no wrong answers in real life. If someone says a watering can belongs in the kitchen, ask why. You may get a good story.
Use the pictures as a prompt: "What did you grow in your garden?"
Sorting real objects, like spoons and forks or buttons by color, is a great follow-up away from the screen.

faq.q: Ese ko timer ke score?
faq.a: Ese. Ese clock, ese score, ese move counter, ese losing. Ko mwin ngan ena ngan mwiniwin, ke ngan ena ngaiye e ngan kiroa ko mwin ngan ena.

faq.q: Ngaiye sorting?
faq.a: Eda ren aikanen e ngan sorting naba e mwin ko kokoro ngaiye ngan ena, naba e ngan ko ngaiye ko ngaiyen. E ngan ngaiye ngan kongiye ngan picture ngan ena.

faq.q: E free ma ese ngan sign up?
faq.a: Ae, e free, ma ese account, ese sign-up, ese download. E ngan ena ngan web browser ko phone, tablet ke computer.

picture-puzzle.name: Picture puzzle
picture-puzzle.seoTitle: Easy Jigsaw Puzzle for Dementia: 4 or 9 Pieces
picture-puzzle.description: An easy online jigsaw for people living with dementia: 4 or 9 large pieces, the whole picture stays visible, and you tap two pieces to swap them.
picture-puzzle.short: Tap two pieces to swap them until the picture is whole.
picture-puzzle.intro: A friendly picture is cut into four or nine large pieces and mixed up. The whole picture stays visible as a guide. Tap one piece, then another, and they swap places. No dragging is needed.
howTo: Choose a picture and 4 or 9 pieces. Four is a gentle start.
Look at the whole picture at the top.
Tap a piece, then tap the place where it should go. The two pieces swap.
Pieces in the right place get a small check mark.
When the picture is whole, enjoy it together, then choose another.
tips: Tapping two pieces to swap them is much easier than dragging for many people.
Talk about the picture as it comes together: "There is the red roof."
A real wooden jigsaw with 12 to 24 large pieces is a lovely table activity too.

faq.q: Ese ko timer ke score?
faq.a: Ese. Ese clock, ese score, ese move counter, ese losing. Ko mwin ngan ena ngan mwiniwin, ke ngan ena ngaiye e ngan kiroa ko mwin ngan ena.

faq.q: Ese ko drag ngan pieces?
faq.a: Ese. Tap ko piece ngaiye, ke tap ko mwin, ke ra swap ngan ena. E mwin ngan eda ren shaky hand ke ngan small screen.

faq.q: E free ma ese ngan sign up?
faq.a: Ae, e free, ma ese account, ese sign-up, ese download. E ngan ena ngan web browser ko phone, tablet ke computer.

finish-the-saying.name: Finish the saying
finish-the-saying.seoTitle: Finish the Saying: Proverbs Game for Seniors
finish-the-saying.description: Familiar sayings with the last word missing. Tap a choice or show the ending, then talk about it.
finish-the-saying.short: Complete familiar sayings together, then talk about them.
finish-the-saying.intro: Old sayings are often well known for a lifetime. Each card shows a familiar saying with the last word missing, three choices, and a "Show the ending" button. After the ending, a gentle question invites conversation.
howTo: Read the saying out loud together.
Tap the word that finishes it, or tap "Show the ending".
Read the whole saying again and talk about it using the prompt.
Tap "Next saying" when you are ready.
tips: Read slowly and leave a pause before the last word. Often people say it before you finish.
If someone gives a different ending, enjoy it. Some versions of sayings vary by family or region.
In a group, one person reads and everyone joins in on the ending.

faq.q: Ese ko timer ke score?
faq.a: Eab. Ekeow tsimin awan, ekeow iko, ekeow bwiema me ekeow eto ian. Wo emarain bita wo magita ian aea reit emago, me aeawa bita wo etet ian e ouga bita dogin.

faq.q: Mwa ouga ne a kowen dorer ean?
faq.a: Bita makur e aea bita ean dorer me e riringen dorer. Ekeow iko, me dorer ian e ouga me e dogit eb.

faq.q: E tor won ribana, me engab ngago aea akawun?
faq.a: Io, e tor won ribana, me ekeow akawun, ekeow sain-ap me ekeow dawnlod. E makur ian web braosa ean tefoun, tablet me kompiuta.

word-search.name: Makur n dorer ian leta ekaile
word-search.seoTitle: Makur n Dorer ian Leta Ekaile ibun Engame ñea Erowida Amwa, Eburiin
word-search.h1: Makur n Dorer ian Leta Ekaile
word-search.description: Makur n dorer ian leta ekaile e tor won ribana ibun engame riring me engame ñea erowida amwa. Ekeow dorer eba, ekaile leta, dorer e ro reit an me iturin dogin. Makur online me emarain buriin.
word-search.short: Leta ekaile, e bwi dorer, ro reit iturin me an dogin. Emarain buriin nukan.
word-search.intro: Grid etangina ian leta ekaile me e bwi dorer, reiet an me iturin. Tap leta me tap bita ro reit iturin. Wo reit beba? Eburiin bita makur e kowen ian te tap.
howTo: Aea bita theme me bita size n grid.
Aea bita list n dorer. Dorer e reiet iturin (ebereit ro reit maik) me reit an (pwer ro reit iturin).
Tap bita leta ian dogin dorer, me tap bita ro reit magin.
Dorer bita wo aea e mark me e ro bita list.
Tap "Print this puzzle" bita wo reiet ean beba me bensir me maka.
tips: Aea bita dorer ian list me etamwi bita leta dogin.
Ean beba, highlighter e marain amwa ngago pencil.
Dorer ean dorer theme. Dorer n wani e riringen amwa n amwa ngago wani, kuk me maket.

faq.q: Tsimin awan me iko ian?
faq.a: Eab. Ekeow tsimin awan, ekeow iko, ekeow bwiema me ekeow eto ian. Wo emarain bita wo magita ian aea reit emago, me aeawa bita wo etet ian e ouga bita dogin.

faq.q: A emarain buriin bita makur n dorer?
faq.a: Io. Tap "Print this puzzle" bita wo buriin grid ian leta ekaile, me list n dorer e iturin. Puzil e kowen ian ngago e kowen.

faq.q: E tor won ribana, me engab ngago aea akawun?
faq.a: Io, e tor won ribana, me ekeow akawun, ekeow sain-ap me ekeow dawnlod. E makur ian web braosa ean tefoun, tablet me kompiuta.

coloring.name: Beba n kala
coloring.seoTitle: Beba n Kala ibun Engame Riring ñea Erowida Amwa (E tor won ribana)
coloring.description: Beba n kala e mada ibun engame riring ian ekaile pija: tap kala, me tap pija. Ekeow mess, ekeow kala eto, me peij me peij emarain buriin e tor won ribana.
coloring.short: Tap kala, me tap iturin pija. Buriin beba nukan.
coloring.intro: Beba ian pija ekaile me e mada: daborao ian bat, mwengara, tiikap, bebe me bot. Tap kala, me tap iturin pija bita wo riringen. Ekeow kala e toba.
howTo: Aea bita peij.
Tap kala. Kala me kala e tsimin etan ean.
Tap iturin pija bita wo riringen ian bita kala.
Kowen amwa ean tsimin awan bita wo riringen nukan.
Tap "Print this page" bita beba mada wo riringen ian bensir me maka.
tips: Kowen aro kala bita e reit aea ngago emarain riring aea me ekeow eba.
Dabugaga e bwoiy me araubum e buru e dogit eb. Makur e mada ean kala, ekeow aea eto.
Beba buriin e marain ian maka me kraiyon ekaile, e reit buoian ian bita.

faq.q: Tsimin awan me iko ian?
faq.a: Eab. Ekeow tsimin awan, ekeow iko, ekeow bwiema me ekeow eto ian. Wo emarain bita wo magita ian aea reit emago, me aeawa bita wo etet ian e ouga bita dogin.

faq.q: Beba kaiki e riringen babiyit eb?
faq.a: A kowen pija mada me e gogora ngago cartoon, bita e dogit eb ibun engame riring. Pija ekaile e riringen kala e reit riring me ekeow babiyit eb.

faq.q: E tor won ribana, me engab ngago aea akawun?
faq.a: Io, e tor won ribana, me ekeow akawun, ekeow sain-ap me ekeow dawnlod. E makur ian web braosa ean tefoun, tablet me kompiuta.

conversation-cards.name: Kat n dorer
conversation-cards.seoTitle: Kat n Dorer ibun Engame ñea Erowida Amwa: Kat n Pija
conversation-cards.description: Kat n pija ian dorer mada ibun engame ñea erowida amwa: ekeow kietsin n test, ekeow aea dorer eto. Aea ean skrin me buriin full set.
conversation-cards.short: Kat n pija ian kietsin mada me oñer. Ekeow kietsin n test.
conversation-cards.intro: Kat me kat e tsimin pija me dorer mada bita oñer dorer, ngago "Mwa meto wara riringen ian ewewit awan?" Ekeow dorer eto me ekeow bita engab wo amwa. Aea bita theme me shuffle kat.
howTo: Aea bita theme, me reiet "All cards".
Oñer bita kietsin ian dorer ekaile me aea bita pija.
Karauwe, dorer amwa, me oñer dorer e kowen.
Tap "Next card" ngago wo reit, me reiet ean te kat ngago wo amwa.
Tap "Print all cards" bita wo tei kat n beba.
tips: Dorer bita kietsin nukan. E dogit eb ngago dorer, ekeow intaviu.
Aea bita stori, ekeow bita pwaek. Ne e kowen amwa, e dogit eb.
Ne kat e reiet dorer n bwarow, karauwe me oñer kowen ro kat e kowen.

faq.q: Engab ngago ekeow kietsin "Wo amwa bita…?"?
faq.a: Kietsin n test amwa e reiet ngago exam me e bwarow. Dorer mada ngago "Oñerita…" e riringen engame me engame e marain dorer, e ouga bita reit amwa.

faq.q: A emarain buriin bita kat?
faq.a: Io. "Print all cards" e buriin bita full set ian leta ekaile, kat eba ian peij, reit bita wo tei.

faq.q: E tor won ribana, me engab ngago aea akawun?
faq.a: Ioh, e free, ma ko account, sign-up ma download. E nara tikim web browser i te phone, tablet ma computer.

photo-pairs.name: Photo pairs
photo-pairs.seoTitle: Make a Matching Game from Family Photos
photo-pairs.h1: Photo Pairs: Match Your Own Photos
photo-pairs.description: Turn your own family photos into a gentle matching game. Choose 2 to 6 photos on your device; they stay in your browser and are never uploaded.
photo-pairs.short: Choose your own photos and match them. Nothing is uploaded.
photo-pairs.intro: Choose two to six photos from your phone, tablet or computer, and they become a matching game with large, visible pictures. The photos are shown only inside this page. They are not uploaded, saved or shared, and they disappear when you close the page.
howTo: Tap "Choose photos" and pick two to six photos.
Each photo appears twice. Tap one, then tap its pair.
Talk about each photo as you find it.
When you are done, close the page or tap "Clear photos". Nothing is kept.
tips: Choose clear photos of happy, familiar things: a pet, a garden, a favorite place, a wedding day.
Pictures of places and objects can be easier than faces, and they avoid any pressure to name people.
Leave out photos of people who have died if they might bring sudden grief, unless you know they bring comfort.

faq.q: Are my photos uploaded anywhere?
faq.a: Ikai. Te page e nang wiwi te photos me ko choose i te browser ma e nang kamot tikim i te screen. Ikai e kaberang ki mwi ma ki ro aroang, ma e ikai nang i te page me ko close ma reload.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: Ikai. Ikai clock, score, move counter ma losing. E nara stop i nako aroang, ma stop i waen e ikai ni wa ngaran nang ni finish.

faq.q: Can I save the game for next time?
faq.a: Ikai i te browser, ni mwi, ke ikai ni store ang mea privacy. Te free app Golden Moments i te iPhone ma iPad e nara keep copies ko mwi i te device.

picture-bingo.name: Picture bingo
picture-bingo.seoTitle: Picture Bingo for Seniors with Dementia: Printable
picture-bingo.description: Free printable picture bingo for memory care and senior groups, with a large on-screen caller. Big pictures with words, 9 or 16 squares, no reading needed.
picture-bingo.short: Printable picture bingo cards and a big-screen caller for groups.
picture-bingo.intro: Classic bingo with pictures instead of numbers, so no one needs to read small print. Print a set of unique cards, then use the on-screen caller to show each picture large on a TV, laptop or tablet.
howTo: Choose 9 or 16 squares per card and how many players.
Tap "Print cards". Each card is different.
Open the caller on a large screen. Tap "Next picture" to show each picture with its name.
Players cover the matching picture on their card with a coin, button or marker.
Everyone who fills a row, or the whole card, gets a cheer. There are no losers in this version: keep playing until everyone has a line.
tips: Use large tokens such as checkers or bottle caps. Small buttons can be hard to pick up.
Name the picture and say something about it: "A sailboat. Who has been out on a boat?"
Sit people with difficulty seeing closest to the screen, and pair helpers with players who need them.
Nine squares is plenty for most groups. Keep the session around 20 to 30 minutes.

faq.q: How do I run picture bingo in a care home?
faq.a: Print one card per player, put the caller on the biggest screen you have, and call pictures slowly, naming each one. Play until everyone has a line, so no one is left out.

faq.q: Is it free to print?
faq.a: Ioh. Print as many cards as you need, as often as you like, for personal or group use.

faq.q: Can people play without reading?
faq.a: Ioh. Every square is a large picture, with its name underneath for those who like words.

calm-breathing.name: Calm breathing
calm-breathing.seoTitle: A Calm Breathing Pause for Seniors and Caregivers
calm-breathing.description: A slow, quiet breathing pause to share: a gentle circle grows and shrinks for six breaths. You start it, and you can stop any time.
calm-breathing.short: A slow circle to breathe along with. Start and stop when you like.
calm-breathing.intro: Sometimes the best activity is a quiet pause. Tap "Start", then breathe in as the circle grows and out as it shrinks. Choose a slower or faster pace. It is not a treatment, just a peaceful moment to share.
howTo: Sit comfortably side by side.
Choose a pace: slow or gentle.
Tap "Start". Breathe in while the circle grows, and out while it shrinks.
It stops by itself after six breaths, or tap "Stop" whenever you like.
tips: Hold hands or rest a hand on the person's arm if that is welcome.
Never insist. If they would rather watch, that is fine.
If someone has breathing problems, breathe normally and simply watch the circle. Ask a doctor about any breathing concerns.

faq.q: Is this a medical breathing exercise?
faq.a: Ikai. E simple, optional pause ni calm ma company. Ikai treatment ni anxiety ma ikai condition. Talk ma doctor ni health concerns.

faq.q: Does the circle move without me starting it?
faq.a: Ia. Ena jeni ta ke ko 'Start', ao ena tur ke ko 'Stop' ke eke ruwe nen ebwin. Ma ke aon ebwe aenaki ta, ao ena kobwe kewa ta ke ena ekanai aenaki ebwin kanadi.

faq.q: Ena kamunin ke e eab ekaiirea ao ena baken ekwe ko ekaiarea?
faq.a: Eng, ena kamunin, ao e eab ekai, e eab ekaiirea, ao e eab kalar ko eiii. E ebwe kar kabwe ko web browser ko telefon, tablet ke kompiuta.
